notes: Puretip One 2.01 on the new station software. Misting and cleaning run in on and off pulses with a cycle count. New Flush Mode, RS232 serial link as an alternative to Bluetooth, firmware updates from Settings, and a maximum Z-axis speed setting. Station faults such as low or empty misting liquid and E-Stop now chime until acknowledged and are logged. Redesigned start-up, warnings and Diagnostics, with sound controls.
